title: Counting the Presentations of Premium That Have Fallen Due on a Plan
content:
The number of instalments of premium presented at once on a Pass and Trip Protection plan is counted by
setting what the covered holding's account shows charged against what the protection account shows raised.

1. Where the plan's premium is collected alongside the covered holding's instalments and that holding's
   account shows more instalments charged in the season than the protection account shows premium entries
   raised on the plan, one instalment is presented for each of the difference.
2. Where the plan's premium is collected alongside that holding's instalments and its account shows fewer
   instalments charged in the season than the protection account shows premium entries raised on the plan,
   none is presented.
3. In every other case one instalment is presented.

**Reading the count.** Both of the first two cases require the plan to be one whose premium rides on the
covered holding's instalments. Between them the question is only which of the two counts stands higher: the
instalments charged on the covered holding's account within the season, or the premium entries already raised
on the plan's own protection account. Where the two counts are equal, neither of the first two holds and one
instalment is presented.

**Condition table (hypothetical inputs).**

| Instalments charged on the covered holding's account this season | Premium entries raised on the plan | The plan rides on the holding's instalments | Instalments presented |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 5 | 2 | Yes | 3 |
| 2 | 5 | Yes | 0 |
| 3 | 3 | Yes | 1 |
| 5 | 2 | No | 1 |
